summary: Wipro Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on June 25, 2026, furnishing its Integrated Annual Report for FY2025-26 and notice of its 80th Annual General Meeting scheduled for July 15, 2026, to be held via video conferencing. This is a routine compliance filing by a foreign private issuer regarding annual reporting and shareholder meeting logistics. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is disclosed. The filing contains no transaction terms, financial offers, or corporate actions beyond standard annual report delivery and AGM notice.
